value.rationale: The source work assesses recoloring count; physical completion time is a different performance observable. A graph-wide rare-edge universality law with explicit quantitative overlap condition explains a half-logarithmic time window for sparse networks and correctly distinguishes hub-dominated constant-time and clique second-extreme regimes. The D2 criterion permits arbitrary local shapes and long cycles without requiring connectedness or low triangles.
